placement_test.HG: host content digest (hypergraph.arrays_digest) == the laptop's for every (dataset, K) the laptop has: the frozen data/l1_canonical/<ds>/hypergraph/H4_SK.json at the native K and the scratchpad/_l1d_scale_parts.py builds at the grid K
placement_test.SHARDS: host PHG shard sha256 list at the native K == the shards of the served run (metaqa, squad: data/l1_lowmem/<ds>/stream/H4_SK_STREAM_V1.json; musique: the served LOWMEM__PHG_C1_con record)
placement_test.PHG: host vector at the native K == the served vector position by position (metaqa LOWMEM__PHG_REPAIR1_con, squad LOWMEM__PHG_con, musique LOWMEM__PHG_C1_con); host grid-K vectors, where run, == the laptop grid maps of results/L1_DEV/kscale_<ds>__v1.json
placement_test.verdict_rule: BIT_IDENTICAL if every comparison is equal. Otherwise NOT_IDENTICAL: host maps carry the placement label HOST_U2404, are never pooled with laptop maps without that label, and the user rules whether they are admissible. No retries to obtain a match, no parameter change, no toolchain swap without a ruling.
placement_test.where: compared on the laptop from fetched host records and vectors; no host result is used before this comparison

outputs.host: results/L1_HOST/** (records, maps, hypergraph .npz) and work/L1_HOST/phg_data/** (PHG shards, run dirs, dumps; outside the rx output glob)

scheduling.unit: one rx job per dataset stage (HG per dataset, PHG per (dataset, K)), so the host scheduler queues by capacity
scheduling.reservation: HG 2 cpus; PHG 4 cpus (NP 4 ranks); memory reserved per dataset from the input size
scheduling.priority: the user's 'medium priority under contention, full utilization when free': rx FIFO + backfill by reservation; the capacity reserve (2 CPUs, 8 GB) is left as it is; no other user's job is cancelled, rerun or gc'd
scheduling.timeouts: PHG mpirun harness timeout 12 h (a harness limit, not a partitioner parameter)

kept: PHG contract: NP 4, PARAMS, PHG_NONEMPTY_REPAIR_V1; no tuning or relaxation; PARTITION_INVALID -> the cell is absent
CONTRACT_FILES and pinned modules imported unchanged; the lane modules are redirected at runtime only (common.DISTRO, common.DATA)
no credentials on the host (no Modal, Hugging Face or cloud tokens; no --var values)
no download other than the authorized apt packages
held-out rows are not read; TEST is never read
gpu: no declared stage uses the GPU: PHG is CPU/MPI and the hypergraph build is numpy on CPU. The GPU stays free for other users; L1's GPU-shaped work (dense/SPLADE scoring) is already cached.
